consent.text: 🔒 Consent to data processing Before using NosiFit, read the privacy policy. By pressing the button below you: 1) confirm that you are at least 16 years old; 2) accept the privacy policy; 3) give your explicit consent to the processing of your health data (weight, nutrition, workouts, sleep, habits) for the service to work and for its aggregated internal statistics. Withdraw consent: /withdraw. Get your data: /mydata.
consent.saved: ✅ Thank you! Your consent is saved, you can continue.
consent.mydata: 📦 Your data You can download a file with all your data on the website: {site}/privacy/my-data If you signed in only via Telegram and have no password: 1) open {site}/auth/reset and enter the email of your account; 2) set a password with the link from the message; 3) sign in on the website and open the link above. The bot does not send the data file to the chat, so your data does not stay in the Telegram history.
consent.withdraw_prompt: ⚠️ Withdraw consent to the processing of health data? The following will be deleted immediately: nutrition, water, weight, workouts, sleep, habits, profile data and the internal statistics about your actions. The account and sign-in methods will stay. This cannot be undone. Save your data first: /mydata
consent.withdrawn: Consent withdrawn, records deleted. The account stays: to use NosiFit again, give your consent: /consent
